camel_example: aliyun cms DescribeCustomEventCount --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime 1552220485596 --StartTime 1552209685596 --EventId 123 --SearchKeywords cms --Name BABEL_BUY --GroupId 12345
description_en: Queries the number of times that a custom event occurred within a period of time
description_zh: 调用DescribeCustomEventCount接口查询自定义事件的统计结果
kebab_example: aliyun cms describe-custom-event-count --name BABEL_BUY --event-id 123 --group-id 12345 --search-keywords cms --start-time 1552209685596 --end-time 1552220485596 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCustomEventCount

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The keywords that are used to search for the event.

If you need to query the custom event whose content contains a and b, set the value to a and b.

If you need to query the custom event whose content contains a or b, set the value to a or b
parameters.help_zh:
搜索事件内容包含的关键字。

如果您待搜索事件的内容中包括A和B，则可以搜索A和B。
如果您待搜索事件的内容中包括A或B，则可以搜索A或B
parameters.name: search_keywords

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间。

格式为Unix时间戳，即从1970年1月1日开始所经过的毫秒数
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。

格式为Unix时间戳，即从1970年1月1日开始所经过的毫秒数
parameters.name: end_time

Code.description_en:
The status code.

The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful

CustomEventCount.description_en: The details of the custom event

Num.description_en: The number of times that the custom event occurred

Time.description_en:
The time when the event occurred.

This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
Time.description_zh:
事件发生的时间。

格式为Unix时间戳，即从1970年1月1日开始所经过的毫秒数

Message.description_zh: 返回信息。当请求成功时，返回成功信息；当请求失败时，返回失败原因

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true and false
Success.description_zh: 操作是否成功。true表示成功，false表示失败
